messages.subject: Whether my  state space model is supported by INLA?
parts:
Hi all，
I read  in chapter 8 of  Bayesian inference with INLA  that INLA can be applied to state space，I wonder whether my model is supported by INLA , my model is as follows:

Q_{t}=exp(y_{t})+exp(y_{t-1})+exp(y_{t-2})
y_{t}=tau_{t}+c_{t}
tau_{t}=tau_{t-1}+d_{t-1}+eta_{t}
d_{t}=d_{t-1}+V_{t}
c_{t}=a_{1}c_{t-1}+a_{2}c_{t-2}+epsilon_{t}

where eta_t, V_t and epsilon_t follow iid ,the parameter are parameter is the corresponding variance and a_1,a_2

Many thanks!
